title: trackerPlanning
responsibility: Validate Tracker planning documents and project the current stage, stage artifacts and promotion receipts from item fields.

inputs.name: trackerStage.value
inputs.description: Stage token from the local API or CLI.
inputs.unknownReason: The request value is unchecked until the planning schema validates it.

inputs.name: trackerPlanningStage.fields
inputs.description: Independent receipts for the entered planning stages.

inputs.name: encodeTrackerArtifact.input
inputs.description: A proposed stage document, or null to clear it.
inputs.unknownReason: The request value is unchecked until the planning schema validates it.

inputs.name: trackerPlanning.fields
inputs.description: Stored promotion and artifact fields, which may be absent on older rows.

outputs.name: trackerStages
outputs.description: Canonical planning stages in promotion order.

outputs.name: trackerPromotionStages
outputs.description: Stages an explicit promotion can enter.

outputs.name: trackerPlanningArtifactFields
outputs.description: Journal fields for the stage artifact documents.

outputs.name: trackerPlanningPromotionFields
outputs.description: Journal fields for the attributed promotion receipts.

outputs.name: trackerArtifactUrlSchema
outputs.description: Validates a credential-free HTTPS artifact link.

outputs.name: trackerArtifactSchema
outputs.description: Validates a stage document with a summary, pages, states and links.

outputs.name: trackerPlanningSchema
outputs.description: Validates the planning projection received by an inbox source.

outputs.name: trackerArtifactMaxBytes
outputs.description: Maximum encoded UTF-8 size of one stage document.

outputs.name: trackerPlanningStage
outputs.description: The highest recorded stage, with Idea as the default.

outputs.name: trackerPlanningStageSql
outputs.description: SQLite stage projection for applying the filter before the row limit.

outputs.name: encodeTrackerArtifact
outputs.description: Validated JSON for the stage artifact field, or null to clear it.

outputs.name: trackerPlanning
outputs.description: Valid artifacts and attributed promotions in stage order.
